messages.subject: missing response in mesh
parts:
hi,

If I include observations in the data with "NA" response but valid covariates for prediction purposes with  control.predictor=list(link = 1), should I include their coordinates when creating the mesh? My sense is no but just to confirm

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] missing response in mesh
parts:
On Wed, 2013-02-13 at 13:52 -0800, Lennon wrote:
> hi,

> If I include observations in the data with "NA" response but valid
> covariates for prediction purposes with control.predictor=list(link =
> 1), should I include their coordinates when creating the mesh? My
> sense is no but just to confirm
>

Setting NA on response you got the marginal distributions, when you
include their coordinates on mesh or not. If you don't include the
missing values, you can fit y in the way presented on Cameletti et. al.
(2012) Spatio-temporal modeling of particulate matter concentration
through the SPDE approach. Advances in Statistical Analysis.
